notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Friends, thank you for your positive feedback![/h3][p][/p][p]We have prepared the first major patch for Static Dread, where we focused on the most frustrating design elements.[/p][list][*][p]Reworked the balance of fish and a coffee pot compared to other items.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the flashlight, a hint appears in the dark.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced the inscriptions on the walls. They have less of an impact on the paranormal atmosphere, and the game does not distract you with them as much.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270007/37550a5c200f62842b85daeb1b45dd67e9329643.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The tentacles have become more dangerous: they slow down the player and have a stronger effect on the mind. We have added a new type — from the ceiling, trying to grab you.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270007/7e1a04acc97ea9bad60706c30e4cc979d6171f2e.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The beholder has been improved in the second part of the game. Hide from it in a locker![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270007/b6d04b3c1a5747df5be9c5f8ad1daa7ffed7a0ee.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The text has been revised in many places, and localization has been fixed. Thanks to the community, [b]Portuguese, French, and Spanish[/b] have been greatly improved. [/p][/*][*][p]Machine translation into [b]German, Turkish, and Korean[/b] has been significantly improved.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270007/b383371893872ee56829652cddd28f7f85eed761.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Plus minor changes:[/p][list][*][p]The noise effect does not remain on the screen if consciousness is not spent.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved sounds when erasing inscriptions and in many other places.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UX: quick exit from windows and fax.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs with the table: localization error when changing languages, when interacting quickly with pieces of paper.[/p][/*][*][p]Low graphics settings have been refined for weak hardware. The game looks better on older video cards without fog support.[/p][/*][*][p]Logical errors with cultists have been removed. They can be sent to dangerous areas without penalty.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45270007/b9172f68dc5b50b4c518d8b3b779422f915b5721.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]We continue to improve Static Dread, so feel free to leave your feedback![/h3][p][/p][p]P.S. Also, if you love combination of narrative and action, please wishlist our other game — Drake Frontier![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1735880/Drake_Frontier/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.6 is now available!
notes.content:
Hey, happy Gamescom to everyone! In the meantime, we’re continuing to update the game to address the most critical issues you’ve reported through Steam reviews, Discord, and discussions.


[list]
[*] Completely reworked the machine translation for German to improve its quality. 
The community is now proofreading it.

[*] Fixed the interaction system: now, even if you stand very close to an object, interaction should still be available.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Secret Ending where Sanity could still be consumed during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed Story Progress elements that couldn’t be obtained on Days 12 and 13, related to the story branches of the Keeper, the Deputy, and Captain Drake.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in dialogues with the Boy on Days 9 and 14, as well as in other text elements.
[*] Minor improvements to the rules for handling strange ships between Days 6–15.
[/list]

Enjoy Gamescom!

notes.title: Static Dread is now available on macOS!
notes.content: [h2]We’re excited to announce that Static Dread: The Lighthouse now supports macOS![/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve tested the game on a MacBook Pro 2015 and found that it runs without issues using Metal, and can work even on older Mac models. However, for the best experience, we recommend playing on devices from 2018 or newer.[/p][p][/p][p]All additional content from the Soundtrack, Supporter pack and Digital Art Collection is also available on macOS. We’re sure our wallpapers will look stunning on Retina displays![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57053/Static_Dread_The_Lighthouse_Digital_Deluxe/" style="button" buttoncolor="#15c138"]Digital Deluxe Bundle[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If you’re playing on macOS, please share your feedback with us in our [url="https://discord.com/invite/f2Dkp4Rv4K"]Discord [/url]- we’d love to hear about your experience.[/p][p]We’re also waiting for Steam Deck verification from Valve and plan to add native Linux and SteamOS support in the near future. The game should already run well via Proton.[/p][p][/p][p]A huge thank you for the overwhelming number of positive reviews! It means the world to us to know that so many people are enjoying the game.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates![/p][p][/p][p][i]— The Static Dread Development Team[/i][/p]

tags.feature: Static Dread is now available on macOS!
We’re excited to announce that Static Dread: The Lighthouse now supports macOS!
All additional content from the Soundtrack, Supporter pack and Digital Art Collection is also available on macOS.
We’re also waiting for Steam Deck verification from Valve and plan to add native Linux and SteamOS support in the near future.

This update includes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where interactions could disappear after dealing with the Beholder.
[*] Improved water visuals during fishing to help reduce motion sickness.
[*] Removed the mechanic where dark entities could destroy items.
[*] Fixed some story consistency issues in dialogues with the Hunter and the Courier.
[*] Minor user experience improvements.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback - and have a great weekend at the lighthouse!

notes.title: Two days until release!
notes.content: [h3]Static Dread launches on August 6th, and we’re both excited and a little nervous! :)[/h3][p][/p][p]This release is very important to us. We plan to keep expanding the world of Static Dread within H.P. Lovecraft's universe, so we truly hope you’ll enjoy The Lighthouse.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Please note: [/b]at launch, only a few languages will be available. Translations are available in Portuguese, German, French, Spanish, Russian and English. The first four are edited by our wonderful community 💚 All other languages will only be supported via machine translation at this time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We do plan to add more translations later on.[/b] But unfortunately, we simply didn’t have the time to finish them before launch. The game is large and very text-heavy, and providing high-quality localization takes time and care.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re looking forward to seeing you all on launch day. And yes — we’ll be offering a big launch discount![/p]

tags.feature: We do plan to add more translations later on.

notes.title: Community translation has started!
notes.content:
Next Fest might be over, but the journey for Static Dread is just beginning!

More than 6,000 players bravely survived the lighthouse, and we dropped 5 patches to make the experience even better and continuing to do so. Thank you to everyone who played, shared feedback, and supported us. You’re the reason we keep going!

Today we’ve also added 6 new languages to demo (automatically translated):
- Simplified Chinese
- Spanish
- Portuguese (Brazilian)
- Japanese
- German
- French

Since these translations are machine-made, we’d love your help proofreading and correcting them! [url=https://discord.com/invite/f2Dkp4Rv4K]Join us on Discord[/url] if you want to contribute to the translation, or offer translation to YOUR language, and message one of the admins for the access.

We will continue improving the game, and we’ll see you on the release 🕯🌊

notes.title: Play Static Dread on Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
We’re celebrating [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest_feb2025]Steam Next Fest[/url] with the new update!

The tides are shifting, and the lighthouse calls once more 👁

After the playtest we received a lot of feedback and comments. Thanks to everyone who played and shared their opinion 💚 We've listened to you, and brought new life (and terror) to Static Dread with a major update! From eerie new events to tools that might just keep you sane, the darkness has never been more unpredictable. Will you survive the changes?

Here’s what awaits you:
- Full gamepad and steamdeck support.
- Rebalanced energy and sanity system. Your consciousness and sanity are now more dependent on the light. Keep the beacon burning to stay sane!
- Rebalanced sound volumes + new sounds.
- 11 bonus tracks for cassette player.
- New UI with frame-by-frame animations and improved artwork.
- Rebalanced store prices.
- The lamp, cassette player and coffee pot are now interactive and help you stay sane. The lamp creates an area of safe light where you can hide from the darkness. Cassette player helps you restore energy. Once every 4 minutes you can drink coffee from the coffee pot without spending resources.
- Many new events. Darkness became more inventive. Shadows now apper inside and outside the lighthouse, and doors have a life of their own.
- Several bug fixes.
- Additional text proofreading and correction of mistakes.

The lighthouse stands ready, its beacon cutting through the growing darkness. But the shadows are deeper now, and the whispers louder. Will you keep the light burning, or will the tides claim you too? 🌊

Dive into the update and let us know how you fare! The abyss awaits.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3491390/Static_Dread_Demo][Play updated demo][/url]

notes.title: 🌊 Static Dread Demo is now LIVE!
notes.content:
It's time to head to the lighthouse and face the unknown lurking there... A terror that chills you to the core.

In the demo you’ll find:

- 5 nights in the old lighthouse
- About 2 hours of gameplay
- All the basic mechanics of the game, though they may still change later in the development process

Remember, this is still not the final version. We’re continuing to improve it, thanks to your feedback. We’d be happy if you’d fill out the survey after completing the demo.

On some PCs, the game may experience lower FPS. If that happens to you, please let us know your PC specs in the survey.

Once you’ve finished the game, come join us on [url=https://discord.gg/FJmfDd5fUT]Discord[/url]! We’d love to hear your impressions 💚
